paragraphs: The BMW X1 xDrive30e is a petrol plug-in hybrid variant of the U11-generation X1, introduced in 2022. It combines a 1.5-litre B38 three-cylinder petrol engine with an electric motor and a 14.2kWh battery, offering a claimed electric-only range of 48-55 miles. The B38 is part of BMW's modular B-series engine family, which has a strong reputation for reliability across the brand's range.
about.boldParagraph: The X1 xDrive30e is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: Because the X1 xDrive30e is a plug-in hybrid, the engine and electric motor work together as a matched system. Fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming a non-hybrid B38 will work on a hybrid car — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
